notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Vampyr (API returned missing), and there is no obvious alternative title. vampyr.fandom.com answers the API, with 18 linked pages, including "Prologue", seven "Chapter" pages (from "Chapter 1: Quarantine" to "Chapter 7: Healthy Carrier"), "Quests" and "Sidequests"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 17 of 28 Steam achievements are hidden; they all sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Two hidden ones are rare ("Bloody roots" at 5.5% and "Not even once" at 6.8%), so they may be optional or playstyle goals rather than story beats, but nothing in the data says so. The game chapters listed on Fandom could later give the main story a finer split. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks low.
